question: From the viewpoint and facing direction of Image 2, which sequence correctly orders the four objects from right to left?

answer_choices.A: white pillar, podium, framed black and white painting, bull statue
answer_choices.B: bull statue, podium, white pillar, framed black and white painting
answer_choices.C: white pillar, podium, bull statue, framed black and white painting
answer_choices.D: framed black and white painting, white pillar, bull statue, podium

caption:
ORACLE SURFACE NORMAL MAP (same camera pose and field of view as Oracle RGB):
Colors encode surface orientation, not object color or distance. RGB channels encode normal components along camera-right (R), camera-up (G), and camera-forward (B): 0 = -1, about 128 = 0, and 255 = +1. Higher R/G/B means a stronger rightward/upward/forward component; a surface facing the camera has low B. Black means missing geometry. Combine this map with the numbered images and Oracle RGB.
